chmmc-2010-fall-tiebreaker-02.title: Orthocenter
chmmc-2010-fall-tiebreaker-02.body:
Since $AD$ is a diameter, $\angle ABD=\angle ACD=90^\circ$. In triangle $ADE$, $B$ lies on $AE$ with $DB\perp AE$ and $C$ lies on $DE$ with $AC\perp DE$, so $BD$ and $AC$ are altitudes and $F$ is the orthocenter. Therefore $EF$ is the third altitude, $EF\perp AD$, and $G$ is the foot of the altitude from $E$. In triangle $ADE$ with sides $8,9,7$, the semiperimeter is $12$ and the area is $\sqrt{12\cdot4\cdot3\cdot5}=12\sqrt5$. Then $EG=\frac{2\cdot12\sqrt5}{8}=3\sqrt5$.

**Answer: $3\sqrt5$**

chmmc-2010-fall-tiebreaker-03.title: Month by month
chmmc-2010-fall-tiebreaker-03.body:
Jan 1 is a Friday, so Saturdays in January fall on Jan 2, 9, 16, 23, 30: five Saturdays. 2010 is not a leap year; a month with $30$ days has five Saturdays iff its first Saturday is on the 1st or 2nd, a $31$-day month iff the first Saturday is on the 1st, 2nd or 3rd, and February never. The first Saturdays: Jan 2 (31 days: yes), Feb 6 (no), Mar 6 (no), Apr 3 (30 days: no), May 1 (31: yes), Jun 5 (no), Jul 3 (31: yes), Aug 7 (no), Sep 4 (no), Oct 2 (31: yes), Nov 6 (no), Dec 4 (no). So the months are January, May, July, October: $4$ parties.

**Answer: 4**

chmmc-2010-fall-tiebreaker-04.title: Inequalities for floor and ceiling
chmmc-2010-fall-tiebreaker-04.body:
$\lfloor a\rfloor=3a+6$ gives $3a+6\le a<3a+7$, so $-\frac72<a\le-3$. $\lceil a\rceil=4a+9$ gives $4a+8<a\le4a+9$, so $-3\le a<-\frac83$. Hence $a=-3$, and indeed $3(-3)+6=-3=4(-3)+9$.

**Answer: $-3$**
